visualCharacteristics.description: Horizontal shadowed white tiles: ~80px line icon left (25%), centred (linked) bold navy title + grey description right; 2-4 per row, a single tile is centred at one third width. On a black-bg band: unboxed white text tiles with thin dividers.

contentPattern.description: 1 row per tile: [icon image (~80px) | title (h3, optionally linked) + description paragraph].
contentPattern.structure: 1 row per tile: [icon | linked h3 title + description]
